notes: A shell from a session that is not the pending run's driver. An opaque call cannot be placed against a directory, so identity is the only thing that could bind it, and this session is not the one that asked - it allows. The replay harness mounts state_fixture at cwd_layout under a temporary directory and rewrites the payload cwd and every absolute path in the tool input to that mount point; the paths below are written against the canonical layout <cwd>/.maister/umbrella/runs/<run-id>/.
